name: markdown-tree-view
description: Convert a Markdown document into a self-contained offline HTML tree.

scripts.format: prettier src/**/*.ts build.ts eslint.config.mjs tsconfig*.json package.json --write
scripts.format:check: prettier src/**/*.ts build.ts eslint.config.mjs tsconfig*.json package.json --check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run type-check
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run build -- --check
